surface_definition.P_c0_definition: lambda_c0 times undistorted normalized camera ray; camera coordinates in mm
surface_definition.residual_definition: height_residual=Zg-(a_position*S+b_position)-true_height; a/b are repeat-1 session_linear ground proxies
surface_definition.Zg_definition: final Frozen C1 reconstructed ground Z, including the current reconstruction path; no additional correction
surface_definition.height_inlier_definition: same XY robust height-line inlier protocol as existing C1 gauge replay
surface_definition.jacobian_definition: central finite difference of final C1 lambda and final ground Zg with respect to original pixel u/v
surface_definition.heldout_policy: 50mm is held-out validation only; not used to define q, scales, tolerance, or any fitted model; its q-domain overlap is used only for post-hoc cross-domain coverage classification

q_definition.heldout_policy: 50mm is held-out validation only; not used to define q, scales, tolerance, or any fitted model; its q-domain overlap is used only for post-hoc cross-domain coverage classification

position_rank_definition.rule: within each height, ascending formal-analysis q1 median

rank_residual_continuity.definition: descriptive adjacent-height change at the same ascending-q1 rank; not a same-(q1,q2) comparison
